TABLE main.bart_lines -- This table stores information about Bay Area Rapid Transit (BART) lines.
  name text -- The name of the BART line.
  color text -- The color associated with the BART line.
  path_json text -- A JSON representation of the BART line's path.
  polyline text -- A textual representation of the BART line's geometry.

TABLE main.birth_france_by_region -- This table contains yearly birth counts by department in France, along with a timestamp.
  DEPT_ID text -- The identifier for a department in France.
  2003 int8 -- The number of births in 2003 for the corresponding department.
  2004 int8 -- The number of births in 2004 for the corresponding department.
  2005 int8 -- The number of births in 2005 for the corresponding department.
  2006 int8 -- The number of births in 2006 for the corresponding department.
  2007 int8 -- The number of births in 2007 for the corresponding department.
  2008 int8 -- The number of births in 2008 for the corresponding department.
  2009 int8 -- The number of births in 2009 for the corresponding department.
  2010 int8 -- The number of births in 2010 for the corresponding department.
  2011 int8 -- The number of births in 2011 for the corresponding department.
  2012 int8 -- The number of births in 2012 for the corresponding department.
  2013 int8 -- The number of births in 2013 for the corresponding department.
  2014 int8 -- The number of births in 2014 for the corresponding department.
  dttm date -- A timestamp associated with the birth data.

TABLE main.birth_names -- This table stores data about the frequency of given names by gender and state over time.
  ds timestamp -- The timestamp representing the date of the recorded name data.
  gender text -- The gender associated with the name data.
  name text -- The given name recorded in the data.
  num int8 -- The total number associated with the name, gender, and state.
  state text -- The state associated with the name data.
  num_boys int8 -- The number of boys given the name in the state.
  num_girls int8 -- The number of girls given the name in the state.

TABLE main.cleaned_sales_data -- This table stores details about individual sales transactions, including order information, customer details, and product specifics.
  order_date timestamp -- The date and time the order was placed.
  price_each float8 -- The price of each individual item in the order.
  sales float8 -- The total sales amount for the order line.
  address_line1 text -- The first line of the customer's address.
  address_line2 text -- The second line of the customer's address.
  order_line_number int8 -- The sequential number of the line item within an order.
  quantity_ordered int8 -- The number of items ordered on that line.
  order_number int8 -- A unique identifier for the order.
  quarter int8 -- The quarter of the year the order was placed.
  year int8 -- The year the order was placed.
  month int8 -- The month the order was placed.
  msrp int8 -- The manufacturer's suggested retail price.
  contact_last_name text -- The last name of the contact person for the order.
  contact_first_name text -- The first name of the contact person for the order.
  postal_code text -- The postal code of the customer's address.
  customer_name text -- The name of the customer.
  deal_size text -- A categorization of the size of the deal.
  product_code text -- A unique code identifying the product.
  product_line text -- The product line the product belongs to.
  state text -- The state of the customer's address.
  status text -- The status of the order.
  city text -- The city of the customer's address.
  country text -- The country of the customer's address.
  phone text -- The phone number of the contact person.
  territory text -- The sales territory associated with the order.

TABLE main.flights -- This table stores information about individual flights, including schedule, timing, and delay details.
  YEAR int8 -- The year the flight occurred.
  MONTH int8 -- The month the flight occurred.
  DAY int8 -- The day of the month the flight occurred.
  DAY_OF_WEEK int8 -- The day of the week the flight occurred.
  AIRLINE text -- The airline operating the flight.
  FLIGHT_NUMBER int8 -- The numerical identifier for the flight.
  TAIL_NUMBER text -- The unique identifier for the aircraft.
  ORIGIN_AIRPORT text -- The code for the airport where the flight originated.
  DESTINATION_AIRPORT text -- The code for the airport where the flight was scheduled to land.
  SCHEDULED_DEPARTURE int8 -- The scheduled departure time as an integer.
  DEPARTURE_TIME float8 -- The actual departure time of the flight.
  DEPARTURE_DELAY float8 -- The amount of time the flight's departure was delayed.
  TAXI_OUT float8 -- The time spent taxiing out for departure.
  WHEELS_OFF float8 -- The time the aircraft's wheels left the ground.
  SCHEDULED_TIME int8 -- The scheduled flight duration as an integer.
  ELAPSED_TIME float8 -- The total elapsed time of the flight.
  AIR_TIME float8 -- The time the aircraft was airborne.
  DISTANCE int8 -- The distance of the flight.
  WHEELS_ON float8 -- The time the aircraft's wheels touched down.
  TAXI_IN float8 -- The time spent taxiing in upon arrival.
  SCHEDULED_ARRIVAL int8 -- The scheduled arrival time as an integer.
  ARRIVAL_TIME float8 -- The actual arrival time of the flight.
  ARRIVAL_DELAY float8 -- The amount of time the flight's arrival was delayed.
  DIVERTED int8 -- An indicator of whether the flight was diverted.
  CANCELLED int8 -- An indicator of whether the flight was cancelled.
  CANCELLATION_REASON text -- The reason for flight cancellation.
  AIR_SYSTEM_DELAY float8 -- The delay caused by the air carrier's system.
  SECURITY_DELAY float8 -- The delay caused by security procedures.
  AIRLINE_DELAY float8 -- The delay caused by the airline.
  LATE_AIRCRAFT_DELAY float8 -- The delay caused by a late arriving aircraft.
  WEATHER_DELAY float8 -- The delay caused by weather conditions.
  ds timestamp -- A timestamp associated with the flight record.
  AIRPORT text -- The airport associated with a flight leg.
  CITY text -- The city where the airport is located.
  STATE text -- The state where the airport is located.
  COUNTRY text -- The country where the airport is located.
  LATITUDE float8 -- The latitude coordinate of the airport.
  LONGITUDE float8 -- The longitude coordinate of the airport.
  AIRPORT_DEST text -- The destination airport code.
  CITY_DEST text -- The city where the destination airport is located.
  STATE_DEST text -- The state where the destination airport is located.
  COUNTRY_DEST text -- The country where the destination airport is located.
  LATITUDE_DEST float8 -- The latitude coordinate of the destination airport.
  LONGITUDE_DEST float8 -- The longitude coordinate of the destination airport.

TABLE main.hierarchical_dataset -- This table stores hierarchical data with counts associated with each level.
  id int8 -- A unique numerical identifier for a record.
  parent float8 -- A numerical identifier referencing the parent of this record in the hierarchy.
  name text -- A textual name for this record.
  count int8 -- A numerical count associated with this record.

TABLE main.international_sales -- This table records details about international sales transactions.
  id int8 -- A unique identifier for each sales transaction.
  transaction_date timestamp -- The date and time the sales transaction occurred.
  region text -- The region where the sale took place.
  country text -- The country where the sale took place.
  product_category text -- The category of the product sold.
  product_name text -- The name of the product sold.
  quantity int8 -- The number of units of the product sold in the transaction.
  unit_price float8 -- The price of a single unit of the product sold.
  revenue float8 -- The total revenue generated from the transaction.
  cost float8 -- The cost associated with the transaction.
  profit float8 -- The profit generated from the transaction.
  currency_code text -- The code representing the currency used in the transaction.
  currency_symbol text -- The symbol representing the currency used in the transaction.

TABLE main.long_lat -- This table stores location-based data, including coordinates, address details, and associated measurements.
  LON float8 -- Represents a longitude coordinate.
  LAT float8 -- Represents a latitude coordinate.
  NUMBER text -- Contains a street number.
  STREET text -- Contains a street name.
  UNIT text -- Contains a unit or apartment number.
  CITY text -- Contains a city name.
  DISTRICT text -- Contains a district or neighborhood name.
  REGION text -- Contains a region name.
  POSTCODE int8 -- Contains a postal code.
  ID text -- Contains a unique identifier.
  datetime timestamp -- Contains a date and time.
  occupancy float8 -- Represents an occupancy value.
  radius_miles float8 -- Represents a radius in miles.
  geohash text -- Contains a geohash string representing the location.
  delimited text -- Contains a delimited string of data.

TABLE main.members_channels_2 -- This table appears to represent the relationship between members and channels.
  channel_name text -- This column stores the name of a channel.
  member_name text -- This column stores the name of a member.

TABLE main.messages -- This table stores message data, likely from a communication platform.
  bot_profile__updated timestamp -- Timestamp indicating when the associated bot profile was last updated.
  last_read text -- Text indicating the last read timestamp or identifier.
  ts timestamp -- Timestamp representing the message's creation or delivery time.
  bot_profile__team_id text -- Text identifier for the team associated with the bot profile.
  bot_profile__app_id text -- Text identifier for the application associated with the bot profile.
  bot_profile__name text -- Text name of the bot profile.
  bot_profile__id text -- Text identifier for the bot profile.
  parent_user_id text -- Text identifier for the parent user associated with the message.
  client_msg_id text -- Text identifier for the message as known to the client.
  icons__emoji text -- Text representing an emoji icon associated with the message.
  channel_id text -- Text identifier for the channel the message belongs to.
  source_team text -- Text specifying the source team for the message.
  thread_ts text -- Text identifier indicating the thread the message is part of.
  old_name text -- Text representing a previous name associated with the message.
  latest_reply text -- Text representing the latest reply to the message.
  user_team text -- Text specifying the user's team.
  bot_id text -- Text identifier for the bot associated with the message.
  file_id text -- Text identifier for a file associated with the message.
  username text -- Text username associated with the message.
  permalink text -- Text providing a permanent link to the message.
  name text -- Text name associated with the message.
  team text -- Text identifier for the team associated with the message.
  subtype text -- Text describing the subtype of the message.
  topic text -- Text representing the topic of the message or channel.
  inviter text -- Text identifier for the user who invited a participant.
  purpose text -- Text describing the purpose of the channel or message.
  type text -- Text indicating the type of message.
  user text -- Text identifier of the user associated with the message.
  text text -- Text content of the message.
  bot_profile__deleted text -- Text indicating whether the bot profile is deleted.
  display_as_bot text -- Text indicating whether to display as a bot.
  is_delayed_message text -- Text indicating if the message was delayed.
  is_starred text -- Text indicating if the message is starred.
  is_intro text -- Text indicating if the message is an introductory message.
  upload bool -- Boolean flag indicating whether the message is an upload.
  subscribed text -- Text indicating subscription status.
  reply_users_count float8 -- Floating-point number representing the count of users who replied to the message.
  unread_count text -- Text representing the number of unread messages.
  reply_count float8 -- Floating-point number representing the count of replies to the message.
  file_ids text -- Text containing identifiers for files associated with the message.
  pinned_to text -- Text indicating where the message is pinned.
  reply_users text -- Text containing identifiers of users who replied to the message.
  reactions text -- Text representing reactions to the message.
  blocks text -- Text containing block data, potentially representing structured message content.

TABLE main.messages_channels -- This table stores messages associated with channels, including a timestamp and the message content.
  ts timestamp -- The timestamp when the message was recorded.
  name text -- The name associated with the message.
  text text -- The text content of the message.

TABLE main.new_members_daily -- This table tracks the daily count of new members.
  date timestamp -- The date for which new member data is recorded.
  new_members float8 -- The number of new members on a given date.

TABLE main.project_management -- This table stores information about projects, their phases, and associated details like timing, description, status, and priority.
  start_time int8 -- Represents the start time of a project phase or task as a numerical value.
  end_time int8 -- Represents the end time of a project phase or task as a numerical value.
  project text -- Identifies the project to which the record belongs.
  phase text -- Indicates the stage or phase of the project.
  description text -- Provides a textual description of the project phase or task.
  status text -- Indicates the current status of the project phase or task.
  priority text -- Represents the priority level assigned to the project phase or task.

TABLE main.sf_population_polygons -- This table stores population data associated with geographic areas defined by zip codes.
  zipcode int8 -- The postal code identifying the geographic area.
  population int8 -- The number of residents within the associated zip code area.
  area float8 -- The size of the geographic area, measured as a floating-point number.
  contour text -- A textual representation defining the boundary of the geographic area.

TABLE main.threads -- This table stores information about conversational threads within a messaging system.
  ts timestamp -- The timestamp when the thread was created or updated.
  client_msg_id text -- A client-specific identifier for the message.
  channel_id text -- An identifier for the channel the thread belongs to.
  thread_ts text -- A timestamp specifically identifying the thread.
  latest_reply text -- A timestamp indicating the latest reply in the thread.
  team text -- An identifier for the team associated with the thread.
  type text -- The type of thread.
  user text -- The user associated with the thread.
  text text -- The text content of the thread's initial message.
  subscribed text -- Indicates whether a user is subscribed to the thread.
  reply_count float8 -- The number of replies in the thread.
  reply_users text -- Identifiers of users who have replied to the thread.
  blocks text -- Data, possibly structured, relating to the thread.
  reply_users_count float8 -- A numerical count of the users who have replied to the thread.

TABLE main.unicode_test -- This table stores text phrases with associated dates and numerical values, potentially including entries with missing data.

  phrase text -- A text phrase.
  short_phrase text -- A shorter text phrase.
  dttm date -- A date and time value.
  value float8 -- A floating-point numerical value.

  is_owner bool -- Indicates whether the user is an owner.
  deleted bool -- Indicates whether the user record is deleted.
  tz_offset float8 -- The offset of the user's time zone.

TABLE main.users_channels-uzooNNtSRO -- This table stores counts associated with pairs of channels.
